chapter.title: OF OFFENCES AFFECTING THE HUMAN BODY

heading: Unlawful compulsory labour.
text:
Whoever unlawfully compels any person to labour against the will of that person, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine, or with both.
[1][Sexual offences]
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: Subs. by Act 43 of 1983, s. 3, for the heading “Of rape” and ss. 375 and 376.
